name: Nakadomari (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nakadomari town emblem in orange, blue and green: an orange stylised human figure crossed by a blue and green ring.
history: Municipal flag of Nakadomari, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 March 2005.

features.role: Nakadomari town emblem — an orange stylised human figure crossed by a blue and green ring
